artists.biography:
Matthew Charles "Matt" Berry (born 2 May 1974) is an English actor, writer, comedian and musician. Berry is perhaps best known for his appearances in The IT Crowd, Garth Marenghi's Darkplace, The Mighty Boosh, and Snuff Box. He is renowned for his deep voice; he has voiced several advertisements, most notably for Volvic, The Natural Confectionery Company, Absolute Radio, and MoneySupermarket.

As a musician, Berry composed all the music for Snuff Box, as well as the music for AD/BC: A Rock Opera, which he co-wrote with Richard Ayoade. AD/BC was a half-hour parody of overblown musicals in general and Jesus Christ Superstar in particular, telling the story of the innkeeper who allowed Mary, Joseph, and the baby Jesus to sleep in his manger. AD/BC was broadcast in December 2004 and featured Fulcher and Mighty Boosh stars Julian Barratt and Noel Fielding. He also performed a song for an episode of Garth Marenghi's Darkplace entitled "One Track Lover", a spoof of cheesy romantic 80s songs.

perplexity.description:
Kill The Wolf," released in July 2013 by Acid Jazz Records, is the fourth studio album by English comedian and musician Matt Berry. The album blends elements of rock, pop, folk, world, and country music, showcasing Berry’s eclectic style with a strong influence of 1970s pop and psychedelic experimentation. Its progressive and richly textured sound helped establish Berry as a serious musician beyond his comedic career, featuring intricate arrangements and a blend of vintage and modern sonic elements.

Musically, "Kill The Wolf" is noted for its expansive compositions, including the nearly ten-minute track "Solstice," and a mix of shorter, folk-inflected pieces. The album’s style reflects a fusion of genres, with a focus on melodic storytelling and atmospheric instrumentation. Critically, it received positive reviews, earning a Metacritic score of 71/100, indicating generally favorable reception. The original limited edition release became a sought-after rarity, and the album’s significance was marked by a 10th anniversary deluxe edition in 2023, which included exclusive material and demos, further cementing its place in Berry’s discography as a standout work.
